statewideNote: Every Georgia voter decides these 3 Constitutional Amendments.

statewide.title: Double the farm and timber land that can get a lower property tax value, from 2,000 to 4,000 acres
statewide.yes: One owner can put up to 4,000 acres of farm or timber land in the lower property tax program, up from 2,000.
statewide.no: The limit stays at 2,000 acres per owner.
statewide.needs: a simple majority of the votes cast on it

statewide.title: Probate judges run in nonpartisan races, with no party next to their names
statewide.yes: All probate judges run without a party label, including in the 53 counties where they run as Republicans or Democrats today.
statewide.no: Probate judges in those 53 counties keep running with a party label unless a local law changes it.
statewide.needs: a simple majority of the votes cast on it

statewide.title: Lets lawmakers put existing 911 money in a fund used only for a modern statewide 911 system
statewide.yes: Lawmakers may set up a state fund, paid from existing 911 money, that can be spent only on 911 systems.
statewide.no: No dedicated 911 fund; 911 money stays as it is handled today.
statewide.needs: a simple majority of the votes cast on it
